why: goh bare-hook-index: hook-run scripts that read an index (git diff --cached, git show :path, git ls-files --stage, git write-tree) without goh_bind_hook_index, as the estate stood when the check widened (GOH.BAREINDEX, 2026-11-08). Keyed by the repo's root commit (stable across clones); `repo` is a label. A seeded file WARNS; over its count it is red; an unseeded read is red. Each entry is fixed in its own repo, then deleted here: done is an empty list (crates/goh/src/hookindex/seed.rs).
